preconditions.description: The length of the string is between 1 and 10^5.
The number of kinds of pairs of brackets is between 1 and n.
The number of queries is between 1 and 10^5.
Each bracket has a type between 1 and k.
The position of the bracket to be replaced is between 1 and n.
The type of the bracket to be replaced is between 1 and k.
The range of the substring to be checked is between 1 and n.

postconditions.description: The output for each query of type 2 is either 'Yes' or 'No' indicating whether the substring is a correct bracket sequence.
